label: SEED_AMPLIFICATION_ASSAY
definition: Alpha-synuclein seed amplification assay (e.g. RT-QuIC). No ontology has a specific term, so only a broad mapping is given.

label: Indeterminate
definition: The result could not be called positive or negative.

label: Participant Case
definition: Enrolled because they have the condition under study.

label: Healthy Control
definition: Enrolled as a healthy comparison participant.

label: Prodromal Phase of Disease
definition: Enrolled with prodromal features but no diagnosis.

label: SoftwareAgent
definition: An AI agent, such as an LLM-based curation tool.

label: CLINICALLY_ESTABLISHED
definition: Clinically established (MDS PD and MSA criteria).

label: MDS_PD_2015
definition: MDS clinical diagnostic criteria for Parkinson's disease (Postuma et al., 2015).

label: UK_PDS_BRAIN_BANK
definition: UK Parkinson's Disease Society Brain Bank criteria (Hughes et al., 1992).

label: MDS_MSA_2022
definition: MDS criteria for multiple system atrophy (Wenning et al., 2022).

label: MDS_PSP_2017
definition: MDS criteria for progressive supranuclear palsy (Höglinger et al., 2017).

label: DLB_CONSORTIUM_2017
definition: Fourth consensus report of the DLB Consortium (McKeith et al., 2017).

label: bilateral
definition: Both sides, reported as the mean of left and right.

label: concentration of
definition: Absolute amount per volume, e.g. pg/mL.

label: RELATIVE_ABUNDANCE
definition: Platform-relative signal that is not an absolute concentration, e.g. SomaScan RFU or Olink NPX.

label: ratio
definition: Dimensionless ratio, e.g. a DaT-SPECT specific binding ratio.

label: CATEGORICAL
definition: Qualitative result, e.g. a seed amplification assay call.

label: ON
definition: Examined while responding to dopaminergic medication.

label: SPECIMEN
definition: Measured in a fluid or tissue specimen.

label: MDS_UPDRS_PART_I
definition: MDS-UPDRS Part I (non-motor experiences of daily living) total, 0-52.

label: MDS_UPDRS_PART_II
definition: MDS-UPDRS Part II (motor experiences of daily living) total, 0-52.

label: MDS-UPDRS - Hoehn and Yahr Stage
definition: Hoehn and Yahr stage as rated in MDS-UPDRS, 0-5.

label: SIMOA_HD_X
definition: Quanterix Simoa HD-X analyser. No ontology term exists.

label: DAT_SPECT_IOFLUPANE
definition: Dopamine transporter SPECT with the tracer ioflupane (123I).

label: {NPX}
definition: Olink normalised protein expression, an arbitrary log2 unit.
